incidents-bot: [PAGER] High error rate detected in runtime/gpu-serving-prod → elevated 5xx (500/503) across multiple models. Impact: ~30% of requests failing, queue depth spike. Triggered 2026-03-17T09:11:51Z. Runbook: <https://redwood.runbooks/srv/gpu-serving#high-5xx>.

alex_oncall: ack — I'm on it, starting triage. Can folks grab HPA + pool status and recent warmup latencies?

alex_oncall: quick metric dump:```
$ kubectl get hpa gpu-serving -o wide
NAME          REFERENCE           TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE
gpu-serving   Deployment/gpu-rt   60%/95%   2         10        4          3h
```queue snapshot from grafana: avg_queue_depth=182, p95_latency_warmup=4.8s, p50=1.2s

mira_ops: on it — GPU node pool shows saturation and a backlog of pending pods (image pull + warmup). K8s shows several pods in ContainerCreating for ~30-90s. Manual scale to relieve pressure:```
$ kubectl scale deployment gpu-rt --replicas=8
Scaling deployment/gpu-rt from 4 to 8
```Issuing now, giving nodes a few mins to come up.

deploy-bot: mira_ops triggered scale: deployment/gpu-rt -> 8 replicas (initiated by mira_ops). See <https://ci.redwood/deploys/12345> :gear:

jon_runtime: hypothesis — autoscaler target/migration lag + cold-start warmup causing effective capacity shortfall. Short-term mitigation: divert a % of traffic to a smaller quantized model to reduce per-request GPU residency. I'll open a routing change for 30% to fallback-quant.

jon_runtime: routing command:```
$ redwood route traffic --from gpu-serving-prod --to fallback-quant --percent 30 --note "mitigation: reduce GPU pressure"
```Applying now.

ryan_sre: past logs show enqueues backing up right before 5xx spike, sample:```
[2026-03-17T09:12:34Z] infer: enqueue id=0x7f9 depth=212
[2026-03-17T09:12:35Z] runtime: kv-cache miss, starting model load id=0x7f9
[2026-03-17T09:12:36Z] runtime: failed allocate gpu memory (OOM) for model t0-large
[2026-03-17T09:12:36Z] proxy: returning 503 to client id=0x7f9
```Looks like warmup + OOM attempts triggered fallback 503s.

alex_oncall: after scale + routing: observed 5xx rate -> ~2%, queue depth -> ~38, p95 warmup -> 1.6s. Still watching for churn but mitigation appears effective.

mira_ops: keeping autoscaler overrides in place until HPA settles. I have a rollback ready if scaling causes other issues. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: [PAGER RESOLVED] Symptoms mitigated — automatic alert cleared. Follow-up: create RCA doc and attach logs/timeline. alex_oncall to own RCA.

alex_oncall: will open RCA ticket + link logs (timeline, hypothesis testing, mitigation commands) in ~1h. Thanks all — good job coordinating. :clap:
